label: Adreno
summary: GPU stalled waiting on render completion
explanation: The Adreno driver gave up waiting for the GPU to finish a frame. Often caused by per-frame complexity exceeding the watchdog window (lap-2 tunnel territory in GT5P).

label: OOM
summary: Kernel killed RPCS3 - out of RAM
explanation: System exhausted memory. Reduce graphical fidelity to lower RAM footprint.

label: SPU
summary: SPU recompiler tripped on an instruction
explanation: Aggressive SPU block size couldn't trace a code path cleanly. Safer block size usually resolves.

label: VkLost
summary: Vulkan device lost - GPU stopped responding
explanation: RPCS3 reported VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST as a fatal. Usually the userspace twin of an Adreno fence timeout, but also fires for Vulkan validation crashes and driver bugs. Pattern matches only the fatal F-line so non-terminal device-lost reports don't promote a still-running session.

label: VkSwap
explanation: vkQueuePresentKHR returned -4 (VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST). RPCS3 tries to recreate the swapchain - if that fails the session dies. Often correlates with GPU fence pressure.

label: PPU
summary: PPU livelock - lwmutex acquire spamming CELL_ESRCH
explanation: Light-weight mutex acquisition spammed CELL_ESRCH (Invalid ID). A single hit is normal at startup; postmortem requires >=10 occurrences in the windowed RPCS3.log tail before treating as a signature, to stay above baseline noise.

label: Silent
explanation: Operator pressed R3 (BTN_THUMBR) to fire bin/recovery.sh. The sentinel at $SHM_DIR/r3_pressed.txt is the source of truth; pattern-matching does not apply. R3 origin is recorded in crash_sig as R3_PANIC; STATUS column shows RECOVERY:<sig_label> when a signature also fired, or RECOVERY:Silent when no signature matched (user-initiated recovery with no detected cause).

label: Thermal
explanation: No specific crash signature matched, but peak temperature exceeded ALARM_TEMP. Could be thermal-induced.
